items.title: MLB World Series Games 4-7 missing from the verified slate
items.summary: Forward slate originates all seven World Series games from the official schedule, including Game 4 (mlb-ws-g4, 2026-10-27, Tropicana Field) which the verified layer never lined. Games 5-7 carry official if-necessary flags and are priced for the window but may not be played.

items.title: NBA 2026-10-22..24 fixtures not verified
items.status: PARTIAL: official per-day game counts captured from the rendered calendar; matchup lists for 22-24 October not server-rendered. VF-14 stays open for matchup-level capture.
items.summary: nba.com now server-renders its month calendar, giving official per-day game counts (22 Oct: 2, 23 Oct: 12, 24 Oct: 8, ... 31 Oct: 7), but fixture lists for future dates still fail to server-render ('Sorry, something went wrong'), and the CDN schedule JSON returns HTTP 500. No NBA rows are added to the forward slate: the desk never publishes matchups it cannot verify. Attempt log kept in data/forward/capture_gap_notes.json.

items.title: EuroCup Round 5 card missing
items.summary: All sixteen EuroCup Round 5 fixtures (27-28 October) are captured from the official EuroLeague live API (competition U, season U2026) and appear in the forward slate. They ship unlined because the same API's standings endpoints return empty bodies and the desk never infers team strength.

items.title: GBGB race cards: official Category One schedule captured, per-race cards still unreachable
items.status: PARTIAL/CLOSED for fixtures: the official 2026 Category One Schedule is captured and ten upcoming open races (23 Oct - 26 Dec) are published on the unified dashboard as unlined rows; per-race cards (runners, off times, trap ratings) remain client-rendered or licensed, so no market is originated.
items.summary: gbgb.org.uk returned fetch failures or HTTP 500 on 2026-10-22 (forward capture), but session c12bdcd7 later the same day read the official 2026 Category One Schedule (server-rendered) and published the ten upcoming open races (23 Oct - 26 Dec) as unlined rows on the unified dashboard. Per-race cards (runners, off times, trap sectional ratings) remain client-rendered or licensed, so no greyhound market is originated anywhere in this repo. Attempt log kept in data/forward/capture_gap_notes.json.

items.title: Forward window coverage
items.summary: Slate covers 2026-10-23 .. 2026-11-02: 70 NHL fixtures (the complete official gameWeek card), 7 MLB World Series games and 16 EuroCup Round 5 matches. NBA and greyhound coverage remain blocked as recorded above; tennis/WST/PDC/volleyball/handball are explicitly out of scope for this layer.
